newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle prices steady, few - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle prices steady, few - USDA.

text.p: Compared to Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were steady on few early sales but not tested late, USDA said.
Trade slow. Demand moderate early light late. Seller interest light. Offerings current.
